name: Using AI Safely at Work: The Essentials
description: Follow one fictional US distributor through four everyday AI mistakes (a guarantor's credit file uploaded to a personal account, a customer letter promising a fee waiver that does not exist, a vendor email with hidden instructions for the assistant, and a note-taker that sent a customer the internal margin floor) and practice the decisions that prevent or contain each one in three short Decision Labs.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Using AI Safely at Work: The Essentials

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 7 lessons in 3 modules, play each of the course's 3 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
